description: How shipments move inside Ukraine: all DHL/FedEx imports go to the Kyiv hub for customs clearance, 3 days free storage at the Kyiv customs warehouse, then address delivery across Ukraine or pickup in Kyiv; local couriers (e.g. Nova Poshta) where carriers do not serve the address. Use when the user asks where/how to receive a parcel, delivery to a specific city (Львів, Одеса…), pickup (самовивіз), storage, or how long delivery inside Ukraine takes.
name: delivery_route
title: Маршрут доставки
